title: Chuck and Josh Bust a Few Everyday Myths
summary: Josh and Chuck bust a series of everyday myths: that blood in veins is blue, that most body heat is lost through the head, that Mount Everest is the tallest mountain (Mauna Kea is tallest base-to-summit, Chimborazo is farthest from Earth's center), that the Great Wall of China is visible from space or the Moon (a Ripley's column origin), that stained glass is a slow-moving liquid (it is an amorphous solid, and the wavy look comes from the Crown method), that touching a baby bird makes the mother reject it, that chameleons change color to camouflage (they use chromatophores to signal and fight), and a count of the five senses (interoception vs. exteroception, multiple skin receptors). The episode closes with a listener mail anti-joke submitted by Patrick and Derek and a plug for the Don't Be Dumb video series.

segments.title: Opening banter and show pitch
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck banter about a myth-busting TV show idea and introduce the episode, and Chuck plugs the Don't Be Dumb video series.

segments.title: Blue blood in veins myth
segments.summary: Blood is never blue; veins look blue because of how skin, fat and light scatter and absorb wavelengths at different depths.

segments.title: Body heat lost through the head myth
segments.summary: The myth stems from Army experiments where volunteers' heads were uncovered; heat loss from the head is roughly proportional to its surface area, about ten percent.
topics: body heat lost through head myth

segments.title: Everest vs. Mauna Kea tallest mountain
segments.summary: Everest is the highest above sea level at 29,029 ft, but Mauna Kea is the tallest base to summit at about 33,465 ft; Chimborazo is farthest from Earth's center; Kilimanjaro stands out from flat plains.

segments.title: Great Wall of China visible from space
segments.summary: The claim traces to a Ripley's column saying it was visible from the Moon; Apollo 12's Alan Bean said nothing man-made was visible; it is hard to see even from low Earth orbit without optics.
topics: Great Wall of China visible from space
Robert Ripley believe it or not

segments.title: Stained glass as a slow-moving liquid
segments.summary: Old window glass is an amorphous solid, not a slow liquid; wavy glass results from the Crown method of making sheet glass.
topics: stained glass slow moving liquid myth

segments.title: Baby bird touched by humans gets rejected
segments.summary: The myth that human scent causes a mother bird to reject a chick is false since birds have poor smell; the bird may have been in a flying lesson. Hosts share personal rescue stories.
topics: baby bird mother rejects human scent

segments.title: Chameleon color change
segments.summary: Chameleons change color for physical or emotional reasons such as fighting or mating, not camouflage, using layered chromatophores.

segments.title: Five senses and more
segments.summary: The five classical senses are not the full list; senses are grouped into interoception and exteroception, and skin has receptors for heat, cold, pain, itch and pressure, plus separate sensing of radiant heat, nausea and hunger.
